notes.title: New Demo, New Languages and Some Interface Changes
notes.notes:
See below the new features we have for the game and plans for future updates:

- New Version (Demo): As a way to bring more players to the game, we decided to introduce a Demo version for this purpose. It is a limited version, and among the limitations are: the player cannot change their name, there is no progress tracking, and only a few skins are available. However, it is possible to play anytime and as many times as you want for free.
- New Languages (10): Chinese (Simplified), Dutch, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Spanish, and Russian.
- Added icons to identify sabotages, removed text inside the lobby under 'Match Settings,' and replaced it with ability icons along with their timers.
- Room code can now be copied with a single click.
- Fixed minor bugs.

Plans for Future Updates:
- Emotes during matches.
- Player levels will be displayed in matches (exception: Guests).
- Creation of Meetings (Detective), more details will be explained when released.

notes.title: Version 1.1 - What has changed and news
notes.notes:
[h1]What has changed and what are the plans for future updates? See below.[/h1]

[h2]Innocents[/h2]
(New) Several tasks now have objects spawning in random positions, ensuring tasks are never the same.

[h2]Killer[/h2]
(New) Fake tasks are now generated and displayed on the map.

[h2]Others[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed the golden key skin.
[*] Fixed sounds for two trash bin tasks.
[*] Fixed the animation for some watering tasks.
[*] Fixed an inactive task.
[*] Fixed a critical bug related to the exit key.
[/list]

[h2]* Plans for the next updates *[/h2]
[list]
[*] New skins (Free and Premium)
[*] Addition of new languages
[*] Creation of a Demo version: A limited version to be played for free. We will explain more when this version is added to the game
[/list]
